=== note positions
participant A
participant B
note left of A : left
note right of B : right
note over A : over
note over A, B : over both
note over B , A #yellow : reversed
=== note shapes
participant A
hnote over A : hex
rnote over A : box
note left of A #pink : colored
note right of A <<st>> : stereo
note <<st2>> left of A : stereo first
=== note url
participant A
note left of A [[http://x.com]] : link
=== multiline notes
participant A
note left of A
  line 1
    line 2
end note
note over A, B
  shared
endnote
hnote right of A #red
  hex
end hnote
rnote over A
r
end rnote
note across
across
end note
=== note on message
A -> B : msg
note left : left
note right : right
note top : top
note bottom : bottom
note left #red : colored
note right <<st>> : stereo
note left [[http://x.com]] : url
=== note on message multiline
A -> B : msg
note left
  multi
end note
note right #pink
  pink
end note
=== note on exo
[-> A : in
note left : changed to right
A ->] : out
note right : changed to left
=== note on reference
ref over A : r
note left : on ref
note top : ignored
=== note on nothing
note left : nothing
=== note over before message
note over A : first
=== note on divider
A -> B
== d ==
note left : on divider
=== note across
note across : all
hnote across #yellow : hex across
note accross : typo
=== note across multiline typo
note accross
x
end note
=== vmerge
A -> B
note left of A : one
/ note right of B : two
/ note over A : three
=== parallel notes
A -> B
& note left of A : par
& note over A, B : par2
=== empty note
participant A
note left of A
end note
=== bad note color
note left of A #nosuch : x
=== bad note on message color
A -> B
note left #nosuch : x
=== note of without space
participant A
note left ofA : x
=== note autonumber variable
autonumber
A -> B
note left : %autonumber%
=== note stereo on message colors
skinparam noteBackgroundColor<<st>> #red
A -> B
note left <<st>> : x
note over A <<st>> : y
=== quoted note participant
note left of "Long A" : x
note over "Long A", "B b" : y
